The Broken Thrones — Battles

You command Arden (red, west). Terfein (blue, east). Break every enemy unit to win. Best played with the phone sideways.

  • Select: tap a unit's banner or its men, or a card at the bottom.
  • Move: with units selected, tap the ground. Double-tap to run there.
  • Attack: tap an enemy unit. Double-tap it to charge at a run.
  • Several units: turn on Multi and tap units, or use Box and drag a box.
  • Group: select 2 to 4 units, press Group. They move together at the pace of the slowest and keep their shape. Tap a G button to reselect.
  • Pan: drag. Zoom: pinch (or mouse wheel).
  • Hills (shaded raised ground): slower uphill, faster downhill, +2 attack fighting downhill, extra range for archers on top. Units on high ground show ▲.
  • Rivers can only be crossed at bridges and fords; lakes and the sea block movement. Forests hide units and halve arrow damage. Spears beat cavalry from the front; hit units in the side or rear. Broken units may rally once.

Siege of Aurenhall: break into the walled town held by Terfein. Tap the gate with the ram (or infantry) to batter it. Tap a wall with foot soldiers to climb ladders. Select the catapult and tap a wall, tower, gate or enemy to bombard it. Hold the town square for 60 seconds with no defenders near to win. Point at (or tap) anything to see what it is.
